authorization: User-directed issue #451: give WP-210 an executable candidate software lane and bounded consumer-test admission while keeping its full acceptance gate closed.
scope: Bind the existing strict scaffold software lane, bounded feature-consumer test path, and exact concern-to-family identities from #387. Native acceptance and full WP-210 completion remain pending.

checks.evidence: Exact pinned Python, Gradle wrapper, JDK/SDK inventory and worker readiness; no provisioning fallback.

Strict resolved task graph, nonzero passing suites and active-module tests, semantic-family execution, lint, license/module reports and actual method inventories; zero, skipped, failed or malformed evidence fails.
Inspect the actual debug APK and statically verify 16-KiB native alignment; no device/runtime claim.

previous.blocker: Exact module commands, trusted check identities and original-case inventory must be approved by supervised CI/test WPs; Gradle/Android CI do not exist in WP-000.

current.blocker: The existing strict scaffold software lane is executable for current candidates. The 110-family R118 concern mapping is bound for traceability, but this lane does not establish candidate assertions through production consumers, post-device-add cancellation accounting, deterministic lifecycle ownership, hardware/platform behavior, or full WP-210 acceptance. Keep configured=false until #387 supplies candidate-bound feature and native evidence; do not unlock dependencies from this lane alone.

concerns.decision: Keep feature-local mirrors; require tests to invoke the actual feature consumer and compare pinned observable behavior. Do not consolidate modules or count core-helper tests as mirror execution.
A quiet stop is normal completion; service-originated RemoteNodeError.Cancelled remains distinguishable from caller CancellationException, which must propagate.
Exercise actual NodeConfig conversion and production settings-adapter boundaries, preserving source bytes and no-op behavior; fakes and planner-only checks are not equivalent.

Report applied progress once the irreversible device add succeeds, before local reconciliation; propagate caller cancellation, require retry/reconciliation to establish device state before another add, and never claim rollback.
Verify owned-task shutdown and completion deterministically. GC/WeakReference polling is not a pass criterion and no JVM collectibility claim is required.

family_identity.limitation: The binding preserves the exact issue-listed identities and current primary-owner catalogs. It is traceability only; Android candidate assertions, consumer equivalence and WP-210 acceptance remain pending #387.

limitations: This exact delta binds only the existing software command lane and one exact feature consumer test path; configured remains false.
No original family is newly credited, no user-visible partial result is claimed implemented, and no whole-WP, device, hardware, or platform acceptance is granted.
No dispatch, schedule, repository setting, or protected gate is changed.
